adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly removes the Disqus Thor CLI option `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` and all related logic that looked up `category_id` and passed `category: category_id` into `PostCreator` (lib/tasks/disqus.thor). The replacement path `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` ultimately calls `PostCreator.new(..., title:, raw:, ...)` in `TopicEmbed.import` without any category parameter, so there is no longer any way to target an import category via the Disqus importer. This is a backwards-incompatible regression for users relying on `-c/--category`.
